evaluation_scope: fixed 0-35 s whole scans; absolute map-to-GT transform is not closed

alignment.method: one proper rigid Kabsch on Control NOMINAL positions with elapsed_s <=10; same transform reused for every method and timestamp

metrics_semantics: PREFIX-ALIGNED RELATIVE DRIFT; paired per-frame non-GT selected measurements, not causal trajectories

NOMINAL.interpretation: PREFIX-ALIGNED RELATIVE DRIFT of non-GT selected scan-to-map measurements (candidate only when recommended, otherwise nominal); NOT a closed-loop trajectory

WEAK_ONLY.interpretation: PREFIX-ALIGNED RELATIVE DRIFT of non-GT selected scan-to-map measurements (candidate only when recommended, otherwise nominal); NOT a closed-loop trajectory

COUPLED.interpretation: PREFIX-ALIGNED RELATIVE DRIFT of non-GT selected scan-to-map measurements (candidate only when recommended, otherwise nominal); NOT a closed-loop trajectory
